comment: Shared conventions across irvan-putra app projects. Each rule cites where it came from. Per-project exceptions live in projects.json and in each repo's own patuh.json.

commit_author.source: instinct-working-style preference; the email is the load-bearing half, both name forms appear in approved history. github-actions[bot] deploy commits are allowed.

naming.source: Irvan 2026-11-14/15: no L or R letters, no leading I (looks like lowercase L), no people's names, not near big-tech brands. Applies to new names; existing names are grandfathered as warnings.

android.package_source: Decision 2026-11-15: all apps migrate to com.vanipy.* (he owns vanipy.com). Changing an applicationId makes Android treat it as a new app, so a mismatch is a finding to discuss, never something to auto-fix.
android.version_source: Irvan 2026-11-17 14:33: three numbers everywhere, no r14/S1 labels
android.apk_name_source: version in downloadable filenames, early enough not to be truncated
android.checksum_source: GitHub's per-asset digest (release asset 'digest' field, sha256) is the trusted checksum - Irvan, WhatsApp 2026-11-23 13:54: 'yes, let's trust Github here'. Family releases no longer publish .apk.sha256 sidecars or SHA256SUMS files; sidecars on already-published releases are kept but ignored, never rewritten.

icon_family.source: Eleven-app family approved 2026-11-17 ~17:37: rounded-square art, numbers-only full-width version strip across the bottom, readable at launcher size, main symbol left visible. Constants from the shared generator (kemas tools/badge_icon.py).

single_variant.source: Irvan 2026-11-23 (WhatsApp): the app family ships exactly ONE launcher icon variant - a single 192px full-color drawable at res/drawable/ic_launcher.png, referenced as @drawable/ic_launcher. No density mipmap ladder, no mipmap-anydpi-v26 adaptive icon XML, no monochrome layer. Simak 0.3.4 (commit f0b495e) is the reference implementation; earlier baselines (five densities, adaptive wrappers) are superseded.

gallery.source: Irvan 2026-11-17 15:19: one page listing every APK with icons and links

repos_public_source: Irvan 2026-11-16: all my repos should be public
